features.title: Keep an idle thread's prompt cache warm, within a budget
features.summary: Opt-in: after a turn ends, re-send the thread's exact last model request with one output token every intervalMinutes, so the provider keeps its prefix cache; stop after maxWarmupsPerIdle per idle period, a rolling maxWarmupsPerHour across threads, a failure, or when the next turn starts.

configuration.constraints: 1–600 across threads in a rolling hour.
Provider routes to warm; empty warms every provider.

failureModes: A warm-up the provider refuses (for example one output token below a thinking budget) stops that thread until its next turn.
A stopped thread drops its held request, so an idle conversation is not kept in memory for a timer that will not fire.
A changed provider or model drops the old timer instead of warming a cache the next request will not use.

externalDependencies.boundary: DSH's own ctx.llm.stream with the thread's recorded loop request, maxTokens 1 and a 60 s timeout.
externalDependencies.deterministicFake: A stub stream yielding a usage chunk in src/warming.test.ts; timers run on vitest fake timers.
